# telnyx_pronunciation_dictionaries (Data Source)

Lists pronunciation dictionaries, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_pronunciation_dictionary`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `pronunciation_dictionaries` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pronunciation_dictionaries))

<a id="nestedatt--pronunciation_dictionaries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pronunciation_dictionaries`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp with millisecond precision.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the pronunciation dictionary.
- `items` (Attributes List) List of pronunciation items (alias or phoneme type). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pronunciation_dictionaries--items))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the dictionary. Must be unique within the organization.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the resource type.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp with millisecond precision.
- `version` (Number) Auto-incrementing version number. Increases by 1 on each update. Used for optimistic concurrency control and cache invalidation.

<a id="nestedatt--pronunciation_dictionaries--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pronunciation_dictionaries.items`

Read-Only:

- `alias` (String) The replacement text that will be spoken instead.
- `alphabet` (String) The phonetic alphabet used for the phoneme notation.
- `phoneme` (String) The phoneme notation representing the desired pronunciation.
- `text` (String) The text to match in the input. Case-insensitive matching is used during synthesis.
- `type` (String)
